_doc: Per-tier time budgets for tools/pipeline.mjs (spec 2.4, objection 14). Provisional until provisionalRuns PASS runs of the tier are recorded in work/test-runs; a breach is then a WARN naming the slowest five. After that, or with enforce:true, a breach is a FAIL. `npm run t -- --freeze-budgets` writes frozenSec = ceil(p95 x 1.25) from the recorded runs; the file hash is part of gate-baseline.json, so raising a frozen value is GATE LOOSENED.
